issue_request: FHIR-7222 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care DSTU1 change request asking whether ClinicalImpression, Contraindication, QuestionnaireAnswers, CarePlan, Goal, RiskAssessment, and Alert were master files or patient-specific data. The approved resolution said the resources include patient or subject data, are not master definitions of what can exist, and are specific records for a patient or subject; ClinicalImpression and RiskAssessment were to remain draft for DSTU2 review.
initial_application: No current-source commit subject explicitly names FHIR-7222, but the Jira comment records SVN #6766. The corresponding git-svn commit d6c4981fa8fe7d58cc3e1cc393aa8cc0b6a83c54 added or preserved CarePlan, Goal, and QuestionnaireResponse introduction clarifications that distinguish specific instances from generic definitions. Neighboring history shows Contraindication patient-specific wording before it became DetectedIssue, while RiskAssessment and ClinicalImpression already had patient- or population-oriented scope text.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Flag, CarePlan, DetectedIssue, Goal, QuestionnaireResponse, and RiskAssessment, while ClinicalImpression has no active current-build resource entry. Later issue work renamed Contraindication to DetectedIssue, QuestionnaireAnswers to QuestionnaireResponse, and Alert to Flag; later applied and already-audited decisions refined Goal and CarePlan subject handling without reversing FHIR-7222's core distinction.
